paper: Utepov et al., Complex Maturity Method for Estimating the Concrete Strength Based on Curing Temperature, Ambient Temperature and Relative Humidity, Applied Sciences 11(16):7712, 2021
method: Text extracted with pdftotext page by page; quotes are verbatim with whitespace collapsed. Page numbers are PDF pages. https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3417/11/16/7712/pdf returned 403 to curl and to Playwright (Access Denied page); the same PDF was fetched from MDPI's file host (mdpi-res.com).

source.quote: a batch of cement-based concrete mixture of class B25 and grade M350 was retrieved from an operating concrete mixture manufacturing plant
construction is 22.4 MPa, which corresponds to 70% of stand
standard strength of 32.0 MPa on the 28th day

17 vertical cylindrical samples with a diameter of 15 cm and a height of 15 cm [21], 15 cubes with an edge size of 10 cm [14] and 2 boxes 50 × 50 × 50 cm in size [22] at once, depicting the real structures on the site

curing_conditions.value: all specimens and boxes kept together under the same temperature and humidity

source.quote: All the samples and boxes were kept at the same temperature and humidity conditions

sensors.value: temperature sensors at the center of 2 cylinders and 2 boxes, every 30 min for 28 days; ambient temperature and RH logged alongside

source.quote: The temperature sensors were inserted in the middle of the 2 cylindrical samples and 2 boxes and logged every 30 min for 28 days
two more sensors were recording the ambient temperature and ambient relative humidity at the same time

box_strength_method.value: rebound hammer (IPS-MG 4.01 sclerometer), not core or compression tests

source.quote: with IPS-MG 4.01 sclerometer in both boxes and their average

cement_type.looked: all 13 pages: searched for cement, CEM, portland, binder

cement_content_kg_m3.looked: all 13 pages: searched for kg/m, cement content, dosage; no mix proportions table

water_or_wc_ratio.looked: all 13 pages: searched for water, w/c, water-cement

aggregate.looked: all 13 pages: searched for aggregate, sand, gravel; the only hit is a literature mention on page 1 (mass concrete with large aggregate)

slump_or_admixture.looked: all 13 pages: searched for slump, admixture, plasticizer

casting_location.looked: no casting site is stated. Authors' affiliation is in Nur-Sultan, Kazakhstan (page 1), which says where the authors work, not where the specimens were cast.

casting_date_or_season.looked: no date or season given; the only dates are submission (Received 1 July 2021, page 1) and reference access dates. The ambient record in the dataset falls from about 24 to about 13 degC over 28 days, which is not stated as a season by the authors.

maturity_datum.looked: page 2 defines T0 as the datum temperature but gives no value. The -10 degC datum used in our tests is derived from the authors' spreadsheet: each step of their maturity column equals (T + 10) x 0.5 h.
